lines.text: Type 2 diabetes, explained through Raju. Glucose absorption, insulin secretion, insulin resistance, complications. Let's follow the sugar.
lines.tts: Type two diabetes, explained through Raju. Glucose absorption... insulin secretion... insulin resistance... and complications. Let's follow the sugar.

lines.text: Starch is broken down to glucose. In the small intestine, it enters through SGLT1, a sodium-glucose co-transporter, and exits into blood via GLUT2.
lines.tts: Starch is broken down to glucose. In the small intestine, it enters through S-G-L-T one, a sodium glucose co-transporter, and exits into blood, via GLUT two.

lines.text: Normal fasting plasma glucose is below 100 mg/dL.
lines.tts: Normal fasting plasma glucose is below one hundred milligrams per decilitre.

lines.text: Stop one: the pancreatic beta cell. Glucose enters through GLUT2 and is phosphorylated by glucokinase, the glucose sensor.
lines.tts: Stop one: the pancreatic beta cell. Glucose enters through GLUT two, and is phosphorylated by glucokinase... the glucose sensor.

lines.text: ATP rises. ATP-sensitive potassium channels close. The membrane depolarises, voltage-gated calcium channels open, and calcium triggers insulin exocytosis.
lines.tts: A-T-P rises. A-T-P sensitive potassium channels close. The membrane depolarises, voltage-gated calcium channels open, and calcium triggers insulin exocytosis.

lines.text: Insulin binds its receptor, a tyrosine kinase. Through IRS and PI3K-Akt signalling, GLUT4 moves to the membrane in muscle and fat.
lines.tts: Insulin binds its receptor, a tyrosine kinase. Through I-R-S, and P-I-three-K, Akt signalling, GLUT four moves to the membrane, in muscle and fat.

lines.text: In the liver, insulin suppresses gluconeogenesis and glycogenolysis. That's the second way it lowers sugar.
lines.tts: In the liver, insulin suppresses gluconeogenesis, and glycogenolysis. That's the second way it lowers sugar.

lines.text: In type 2 diabetes, the problem starts after the receptor. PI3K signalling weakens, fewer GLUT4 reach the surface. This is insulin resistance.
lines.tts: In type two diabetes, the problem starts after the receptor. P-I-three-K signalling weakens, and fewer GLUT four reach the surface. This is insulin resistance.

lines.text: Visceral fat drives it, through free fatty acids and inflammatory cytokines. Indians are at risk even at lower BMI: the thin-fat phenotype.
lines.tts: Visceral fat drives it, through free fatty acids and inflammatory cytokines. Indians are at risk even at lower B-M-I... the thin-fat phenotype.

lines.text: Beta cells compensate with hyperinsulinaemia. Over years, glucotoxicity and lipotoxicity exhaust them. Insulin falls relative to need, and glucose rises.
lines.tts: Beta cells compensate with hyperinsulinaemia. Over years, glucotoxicity and lipotoxicity exhaust them. Insulin falls relative to need, and glucose rises.

lines.text: Above about 180 mg/dL, the renal threshold, glucose spills into urine. Osmotic diuresis causes polyuria, then polydipsia.
lines.tts: Above about one eighty milligrams per decilitre, the renal threshold, glucose spills into urine. Osmotic diuresis causes polyuria, then polydipsia.

lines.text: Chronic hyperglycaemia damages vessels by three main routes: advanced glycation end products, the polyol pathway where aldose reductase makes sorbitol, and protein kinase C activation.
lines.tts: Chronic hyperglycaemia damages vessels by three main routes: advanced glycation end products... the polyol pathway, where aldose reductase makes sorbitol... and protein kinase C activation.

lines.text: Microvascular: retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy. Macrovascular: accelerated atherosclerosis, heart attack and stroke.
lines.tts: Microvascular: retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy. Macrovascular: accelerated atherosclerosis... heart attack, and stroke.

lines.text: Diagnosis: fasting glucose 126 or above, HbA1c 6.5% or above, 2-hour OGTT 200 or above, or random 200 or above with symptoms. HbA1c reflects about three months, the lifespan of a red cell.
lines.tts: Diagnosis: fasting glucose one twenty-six or above, H-b-A-one-c six point five percent or above, two-hour O-G-T-T two hundred or above, or random two hundred or above with symptoms. H-b-A-one-c reflects about three months... the lifespan of a red cell.

lines.text: Prediabetes: fasting 100 to 125, or HbA1c 5.7 to 6.4.
lines.tts: Prediabetes: fasting one hundred to one twenty-five, or H-b-A-one-c five point seven to six point four.

lines.text: Management: lifestyle first. Metformin is the usual first drug. With heart or kidney disease, SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 agonists are preferred for organ protection. Next episode: Metformin, decoded.
lines.tts: Management: lifestyle first. Metformin is the usual first drug. With heart or kidney disease, S-G-L-T two inhibitors, or G-L-P one agonists, are preferred for organ protection. Next episode: Metformin... decoded.
